body: Hello @bryyyanribo, we have a dedicated guide about [geo search + Angular InstantSearch](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/resources/ui-and-ux-patterns/in-depth/geo-search/angular/) inside the documentation. Note that this guide apply to the version 3 of Angular InstantSearch that is currently in beta. Anyway the concepts applied to the version 2.
